# Highest-Paying Government Jobs in Canada

> Independent 2026 salary research on the 12 highest-paying government jobs in Canada — RCMP and CBSA officers, municipal police, firefighters, correctional officers, air traffic controllers, physicians, pharmacists, lawyers, engineers, IT security specialists, and economists. Verified pay grids, pension details, and the real barriers to entry for each role.

## Guides

- [The 12 Highest-Paying Government Jobs in Canada (2026 Salaries)](https://alexmorganxx.github.io/canada-government-jobs/): Full ranked breakdown with pay grids, total compensation, pensions, and hiring timelines for every role.
- [How to Join the RCMP](https://joinrcmp.ca/how-to-join-the-rcmp/): The complete nine-stage RCMP application process explained in order.
- [How to Become a CBSA Officer](https://joincbsa.ca/services/how-to-become-a-cbsa-officer-guide/): The full CBSA border services officer hiring pipeline, stage by stage.
